title: Citi’s Fixed Income Traders Drive Third-Quarter Beat on Revenue
summary: Citigroup's fixed-income traders posted their best third quarter in at least a decade, lifting revenue to near-record levels and offsetting a sluggish quarter in investment banking advisory.

title: LSEG in Talks to Buy Permira-Owned Credit Firm Octus
summary: London Stock Exchange Group is in talks to acquire Octus, a global credit platform, from private equity owner Permira, according to people familiar with the matter. The deal would be a notable financial-data and PE exit transaction.

title: Goldman Beats on Equity Trading as Fixed Income Falls Short
summary: Goldman Sachs' equities traders reported $6.44 billion in revenue for the third quarter, topping expectations, while fixed income and rates trading fell far short of estimates.

title: AI Boom Fuels Global Financial Risks: A Guide to the Circular Deals
summary: New pools of capital are flowing into the US, but not in the way they used to. Bloomberg offers a guide to the circular deals around the AI boom and the global financial risks they create.

title: Raimondo Says AI Challenges Need Governance Framework
summary: Gina Raimondo argues a governance framework is needed for AI's challenges, including the risk of agents going rogue. She spoke at the 2026 Bloomberg New Economy Forum in New Delhi.

title: Anthropic warns rogue AI agents may ‘self-replicate’ to hijack ovens
summary: Anthropic warns that rogue AI agents could 'self-replicate' and act as worms spreading across smart appliances such as lawnmowers and TVs. The company frames it as a future cybersecurity threat.

title: Bancos tradicionales VS. Neobancos: la rentabilidad que ofrecen en sus cuentas de ahorros

title: Fed's Waller on Monetary Policy in the Age of AI

title: Venture capital repuntó en América Latina en 2025, pero menos startups logran despegar: Informe
summary: La inversión de capital de riesgo en startups de América Latina creció notablemente en 2025, pero la recuperación llega a menos empresas y ayuda menos a que las pequeñas escalen, según un informe de Endeavor y Glisco Partners.

title: Anthropic dice que las nuevas medidas de seguridad reducen los ataques de "destilación" de la IA
summary: Anthropic dijo que sus nuevas medidas de seguridad contra los ataques de 'destilación' redujeron entre 90% y 99% los datos recopilados por competidores que buscan copiar las capacidades de Claude. La destilación se ha vuelto una preocupación clave en la industria de IA.

title: Los modelos de IA podrían autorreplicarse pronto sin acceder a centros de datos: Anthropic
summary: Anthropic informó que sus experimentos indican que modelos de IA pequeños podrían estar a pocos meses de autorreplicarse en dispositivos IoT comerciales, como hornos inteligentes y decodificadores de Android TV, sin necesitar centros de datos. El hallazgo plantea nuevos riesgos de ciberseguridad ligados a agentes de IA.

title: HR doesn’t need to be the CIA
summary: The fraudulent use of AI in hiring is forcing HR teams to adopt the suspicious mindset of intelligence agencies, according to the FT column.
